def rotate(input_mat):

def isPowerOfTwo(n):

def isPossibleTriangle(a, b, c):

def xnor(num1, num2):

def togglebit(n):
    if n == 0:
        return 1
    i = n
    n |= n >> 1
    n |= n >> 2
    n |= n >> 4
    n |= n >> 8
    n |= n >> 16
    return i ^ n

def nCr(n, k):
